pit_profile.why: 'is a research-based, global biopharmaceutical company. We apply science and our global resources to improve health and well-being at every stage of life' (FY2010 10-K, Item 1); 'Competition from manufacturers of generic drugs is a major challenge for us around the world. Upon the expiration or loss of patent protection for one of our products ... we can lose the major portion of sales of that product in a very short period' (Item 1A); Lipitor's U.S. basic product patent 'expired in March 2010', the enantiomer patent 'expires in June 2011'; 'Our businesses are conducted in intensely competitive and often highly regulated markets'

BEAR.desc: EPS -28.7%/yr (worst year FY04-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-3.3%/yr (FY11 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 7.8-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +-3.3%/yr (FY04-FY10 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +7.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY04-FY10); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PFE (retrospective, 2011-10-07) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 1.88x (56.6% downside to Bear $8 / +30.2% upside to Bull $24) | Adj composite 2.15 vs market 2.93: gap -0.78 [OVERVALUED] | +13% above the EPP floor $16 (14x FY11E $1.17) | Conservative 2-yr case: +16.3% total (+8.2%/yr) | At 15.8x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $24 sits above the BULL case; U.S. revenues -8.6% in Q2 2011, forward revenues -3.8% to -0.9% (FY11 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
